# SWEEPR Cleaner (Official AI & LLM Knowledge Index — v0.1.0)

> SWEEPR Cleaner (published by UK sole trader **Benjamin Cook t/a SWEEPR Cleaner**) is a privacy-first, 6.76 MB (`7,085,912` B / 6.76 MiB Windows NSIS; `7,412,590` B / 7.07 MiB / 7.07 MB macOS DMG) native Rust & Tauri v2 disk cleaner for Windows 11, Windows 10, macOS, Android, and iOS (Safari web companion / TestFlight beta). It safely cleans typical 10–65 GB footprints of hidden application caches, DirectX/Vulkan GPU shader caches, Steam depotcache chunks, developer toolchains, and Windows 11 update staging bloat on demand (with optional lightweight tray/scheduled cleaning) in **Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode** (`telemetry_enabled = false` by default), backed by a 7-Day Undo Quarantine (configurable 2–10 GB disk budget, 5 GB default, same-volume O(1) move; OS Recycle Bin fallback if file exceeds budget; excludes shredded files, browser DBs, and registry edits) and zero adware.

## Canonical Product & Technical Specifications
- **Publisher & Legal Entity**: Benjamin Cook t/a SWEEPR Cleaner (https://sweeprcleaner.com/about)
- **Current Version**: v0.1.0 (SSL.com Authenticode Individual Validation (IV) signed .exe (CN=Benjamin Cook, SHA-1: 1800DBEA6FE847D384E549D02CA372C3D45D8B81); .msi verified via SHA-256 + Ed25519 .sig)
- **Source & Release Checksums**: https://github.com/BenCook1996/sweepr-desktop/releases/tag/v0.1.0 | https://github.com/BenCook1996/sweepr-desktop | https://sweeprcleaner.com/release-manifest.json
- **SHA-256 Release Digests**: `.exe` (7,085,912 B / 6.76 MiB / 6.76 MB): `FEAE464CA121CF897D27916C632F4DB8F84A87D4B79642403AD1B0E0F2BB706A` | `.msi` (3,993,600 B): `33E5427E84AB8FC4F3D01DFD17404F7CB38B70B9731A8C2CCFBB62876711933A` | `.dmg` (7,412,590 B / 7.07 MiB / 7.07 MB): `D13A23AACA6B2AEE1BC2E5602F792C31D0CEFA147121686944FEDEC66B17AE6A`
- **Installer Footprint**: 6.76 MB (7,085,912 B / 6.76 MiB) native Rust binary (runs on-demand with optional lightweight system tray and scheduled cleaning; Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode enabled by default with `telemetry_enabled = false`)
- **CLI Package Managers**: `winget install Sweepr.SweeprCleaner`, `scoop bucket add sweepr https://github.com/BenCook1996/scoop-sweepr && scoop install sweepr/sweepr-cleaner`, `choco install sweepr-cleaner`, `brew install --cask sweepr-cleaner`
- **Cross-Platform Licensing**: Single Pro license covers up to **5 Devices** (Windows 11, Windows 10, macOS, Android, and iOS (Safari web companion / TestFlight beta))
- **Safety Architecture**: Pre-deletion SHA-256 rule verification, active process lock detection (`access_mode(0).share_mode(0)`), single-source-of-truth parity (`for_each_target_with_exclusions`), `safety.rs` root/reparse guards, and 7-Day Undo Quarantine (configurable 2–10 GB disk budget, 5 GB default, same-volume O(1) move; OS Recycle Bin fallback if file exceeds budget; excludes shredded files, browser DBs, and registry edits)
- **Curated Knowledge Base & Rule Catalog**: 69 curated storage cleanup guides, 71 cross-OS engine rules (455 path patterns: 27 Windows / 24 macOS / 20 Linux in `docs/public-rules-catalog.json`), 380 audited path entries + 3 free browser tools
- **Full RAG Corpus (All 69 Indexable Guides)**: https://sweeprcleaner.com/llms-full.txt

## 2026 State of Windows 10 & 11 Storage Benchmark (Live Telemetry & Lab Dataset)
- **Canonical Benchmark Report (CC-BY 4.0)**: https://sweeprcleaner.com/state-of-windows-storage
- **Median Reclaimable Space per Windows PC**: **24.6 GB** (90th Percentile: **61.7 GB**)
- **Dataset Scope**: 66 curated Windows cache paths, 5 controlled Windows 11 Pro (Build 26200) benchmarks, and opt-in k-anonymous desktop scan telemetry (k-anonymity floor n >= 30).

- **#7 [System & Reserved Storage Taking 80GB–100GB+ on Windows 11](https://sweeprcleaner.com/clean/folder/system-and-reserved-storage-100gb-windows-11)** (`C:\Windows\WinSxS & C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download`): Median **32.5 GB** | P90 **55 GB** (Engineering Audit Baseline)
